propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code, only in tests, making deployment identity unobservable despite being documented as essential
The Backend Protocol declares no remote_ref() method, but FakeBackend implements one, creating an asymmetry where test doubles are more capable than production backends
RemoteRef.instance should be derived from the configured base URL and injected at Backend construction time, not resolved at call time, to avoid breaking contract tests without ambient config
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone, independent of instance value
Both ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to correct the claim that instance prevents same-vendor collisions and to document that vendor already separates Cloud from DC
The remote_ref() port member must be declared on Backend, implemented on both concrete backends, and tested against real backends constructed with explicit instance parameters and no ambient config
